character: giant leech, glossy dark olive, amber stripe, boneless waves; a wide lipped mouth for speech only, eyes wide above it; her feeding suckers are on her underside, never on her head; two thirds of frame height
props: rubbery tubes plugged into the suckers on her belly, pink fluid crawling along each, white tags on them; they stretch thin and snap back when she leaps; one red crab at the lens cuts them all clip, a white tag on his claw reading ОТПИСКА
motion_rule: the leech is the subject of every window and lands on a new stone in each, head high, never resting it down; the crab works at the lens in every window; no window ends still; shot size never repeats
environment: sunlit shallows at noon, a long ridge of flat stones running from the lens into the water, hard shadows

audio.delivery: smug oily female voice, native Russian stress, greedy and bossy, biting off each word
audio.pronunciation: доноры is do-NO-ry; отрывать is ot-ry-VAT
audio.pacing: 0.5-2.34 first phrase, 2.49-5.14 second, 5.29-6.35 third, nothing after 6.35
audio.lip_sync: her lips shape every syllable, never a voice-over

timeline.a: she rips off a stone with a pop and flies at the lens, tubes stretching thin; the crab snips one at us
she lands two stones nearer, bounces on, hops to the next, belly suckers popping off; the crab runs the ridge
she rears head high and sweeps it across the lens, body waving; the crab snips a stub, pink spraying at us
she whips down the ridge, hauling the stretched tubes
a wave runs tail to head and stands her upright off the far stone; the crab clacks and side steps
she pours stone to stone like thick syrup, head still up; the crab tilts the ОТПИСКА tag into the lens
she rolls off the ridge into the water, two suckers tear free and slap back, then arcs at the lens; the crab cuts three tubes
she leaps back onto the near stone, head high, dragging the bunch in; the crab lunges at the lens
every sucker lets go at once, her body snapping away down the ridge
she swells triple and rams the lens head first, mouth wide and clear; the crab saws at the glass
she balls up, whips round to camera and lands a stone closer; the crab swings and misses
she gallops the ridge in waves, the tubes stretching to threads; the crab jams a claw under her
she rears at the lens, then throws herself sideways into the water, suckers peeling; the crab cuts two more tubes
a fresh tube snaps onto her belly, pink running in jerks, she swells off the stones; a tag flies at the lens unrolling ПОДПИСКА in black capitals, she blinks behind it

must_appear: every tube ends on her belly, never at her mouth; last frame is the ПОДПИСКА tag filling the frame, the leech blinking behind it
negative_prompt: a tube at her mouth or lips, drinking through a straw, her head lying on a stone, her body flat and still, sleepy eyes, staying on one stone, night, dark scene, a talking head, garbled or misspelled words, Latin letters on the tags, the crab talking, two crabs, legs or bones on the leech, subtitles, English speech, any word after 6.35
